[name="阿米娅"]这里居然有一座血魔的法阵。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_003_kalts_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]它依然在运作。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_394_1#2$1",focus="m")]
[name="阿米娅"]我们和“灵幛”作战的时候，凭空出现的血魔法术……是不是就是它的作用？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_003_kalts_1#2$1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]恐怕没有那么简单。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_003_kalts_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]阿米娅，你很清楚。刚刚的法术，就来自血魔。
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[playsound(key="$d_avg_clothmovement",volume=1,channel="1")]
[Delay(time=0.5)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_cnstrctnck",channel="1")]
[Delay(time=1.5)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_394_1#5$1",focus="m")]
[name="阿米娅"]是……血魔的子裔？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_394_1#18$1",focus="m")]
[name="阿米娅"]我设想过，血魔大君已经离开了这片战场，但他的恩赐不会轻易消失。

citations.quote:
[name="Scout"]那么，殿下，这次的简报就只有这些。
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_1296_1#1$1", focus="r")]
[name="特蕾西娅"]看来军事委员会笃定我们会收复C8—10区域的村庄和物资，并在那里建立哨站，他们已经落入了圈套。
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "avg_npc_1311_1#1$1", focus="l")]
[name="Scout"]但……有一些军官，开始表露出与曼弗雷德大不相同的军事策略。这很不寻常。
[name="Scout"]间谍提出，曾看见过食腐者出入军队的营帐。
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_1296_1#3$1", focus="r")]
[name="特蕾西娅"]孽茨雷……
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_1296_1#1$1", focus="r")]
[name="特蕾西娅"]博士怎么看待这件事？
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "avg_npc_1311_1#1$1", focus="l")]
[name="Scout"]博士认为，在萨卡兹的战争之神表露出任何形式的参与意图后，我们的布置会被全盘打乱。
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_1296_1#10$1", focus="r")]
[name="特蕾西娅"]你呢？
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "avg_npc_1311_1#1$1", focus="l")]
[name="Scout"]……一直以来，诸多强大的王庭成员都更青睐主张反击和暴力的军事委员会，这任谁都心知肚明。
[name="Scout"]但出于某种约束——甚至可以说是约定俗成的规则——没有任何一个王庭主动参与到内战中来。
[name="Scout"]若是王庭之主们真的决定在卡兹戴尔与我们开战，那些仍旧没有回归的萨卡兹们，再无法在地图上看见任何巴别塔的标识。
[name="Scout"]而说点现实的，王庭的加入形成的兵力差距同样令人担忧，支持我们的人，大多并非战士或士兵。
[name="Scout"]我们的队伍里也有不少人第一次拿起武器。
[name="Scout"]所以，要说心里话——无论真相是什么，我们的处境都在急转直下。
[charslot]
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_003_kalts_1#1$1")]
[name="凯尔希"]……
[charslot]
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "avg_npc_1311_1#1$1", focus="n")]
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_1296_1#4$1", focus="r")]
[name="特蕾西娅"]……我明白了。
[name="特蕾西娅"]继续观察食腐者王庭的行踪。
[charslot]
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_003_kalts_1#1$1")]
[name="凯尔希"]若是孽茨雷真的按捺不住，那么杜卡雷同样会有所动作。
[charslot]
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_1296_1#1$1", focus="n")]
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "avg_npc_1311_1#1$1", focus="l")]
[name="Scout"]连续三周，“玫瑰河畔并无航船”。
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_1296_1#4$1", focus="r")]
[name="特蕾西娅"]玫瑰河畔已经是十分优秀的间谍系统，她们可以骗过任何人，但唯独骗不过自己的君主。

[name="W"]真晦气。
[playMusic(key="$calm_loop", volume=0.6)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_412_1#6$1",focus="m")]
[name="W"]唉，本来只是想回来的时候，给自己放一发礼炮——
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_412_1#6$1",focus="m")]
[name="W"]结果这骨头架子一停稳，就要看见臭脸色的老女人。
[dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_4087_ines_1#1$1",duration=1.5)]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_4088_hodrer_1#1$1",duration=1.5)]
[delay(time=3)]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4087_ines_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="伊内丝"]W，无论你在这里炸坏了多少结构，别忘了，我们在占领它以后，还要修好它。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4087_ines_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="伊内丝"]谁弄坏的谁修。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_412_1#4$1",focus="m")]
[name="W"]啊？我怎么会修这玩意？！
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4088_hodrer_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="赫德雷"]凯尔希，博士。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4088_hodrer_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="赫德雷"]巨兽的骸骨已经被我们夺取，指挥官厄尔苏拉也被俘虏。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_4088_hodrer_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="赫德雷"]其余的骸骨驻军，都已经阵亡。
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1067_1#5$1",focus="m")]
[name="厄尔苏拉"]……
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1067_1#5$1",focus="m")]
[name="厄尔苏拉"]你就是那位凯尔希勋爵？
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1067_1#5$1",focus="m")]
[name="厄尔苏拉"]我可听过不少你的故事。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1#2",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]你是疤痕商场的人。
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1067_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="厄尔苏拉"]……远在维多利亚的你，也能对卡兹戴尔的一草一木掌握得一清二楚。
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1067_1#2$1",focus="m")]
[name="厄尔苏拉"]看来，那些老家伙说得没错。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]等这里的事务结束，我会通过你，与你口中的那些“老家伙”谈谈。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]留守卡兹戴尔的是他们，而巫妖已经接触到现在管理卡兹戴尔的军事委员会成员。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]他们就快要做出自己的选择了。
[dialog]
[charslot]
[Decision(options="阿米娅和Logos呢？", values="1")]
[Predicate(references="1")]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1072_1#1$1",focus="m",duration=1)]
[delay(time=2)]
[charslot]
[PlaySound(key="$rungeneral", volume=0.9)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_394_1#9$1",focus="m",duration=1)]
[daley(time=2)]
[name="阿米娅"]博士！
[dialog]
[charslot]
[Decision(options="阿米娅。", values="1")]
[Predicate(references="1")]
[dialog]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0.6, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_clothmovement", volume=1)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="娇小的卡特斯女孩撞入了你的怀中。", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[dialog]
[Decision(options="欢迎回来。;……;你身上都是血，受伤了吗？", values="1;2;3")]
[Predicate(references="1;2;3")]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_394_1#17$1",focus="m")]
[name="阿米娅"]我没事。这些血只是……血魔留下的。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1#2",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]阿米娅。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1#2",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]你的戒指……你使用了力量。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_394_1#19$1",focus="m")]
[name="阿米娅"]嗯。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1#1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]阿米娅，让我看看你的手。
[charslot]
[dialog]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0.6, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="阿米娅手上的一枚戒指已经崩解，连碎片都无影无踪。", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_394_1#2$1",focus="m")]
[name="阿米娅"]这是……直面他所必需的，抱歉。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1#2",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]……你对于情感与记忆的运用越来越熟练了。
[dialog]
[charslot]
[Decision(options="阿米娅，你之前还因为解放戒指晕倒过。", values="1")]
[Predicate(references="1")]
[Decision(options="凯尔希，我们需要帮阿米娅再做一次检查。", values="1")]
[Predicate(references="1")]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_394_1#17$1",focus="m")]
[name="阿米娅"]不，博士，别担心。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_394_1#17$1",focus="m")]
[name="阿米娅"]我只是……有些累。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1#1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]仍然是右手食指的戒指碎裂。还好，只是力量使用过度的结果。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1#1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]你又一次因愤怒而燃烧。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_394_1#3$1",focus="m")]
[name="阿米娅"]我……愤怒吗？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_394_1#3$1",focus="m")]
[name="阿米娅"]我以为我会很生气，血魔大君，他残害过很多人。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_394_1#2$1",focus="m")]
[name="阿米娅"]可我所感受到的，远远不只是愤怒。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_394_1#2$1",focus="m")]
[name="阿米娅"]还有……悲伤。
[charslot]
[dialog]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0.6, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="悲伤。", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n恍惚间，一双永远藏着悲伤的粉色眸子在凯尔希的回忆间闪过。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n凯尔希停顿了几秒，又再度端详起阿米娅的手指。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1#1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]这些戒指，本意是为了帮你适应魔王的力量，和伴随而来的汹涌情感。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1#1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]又一枚戒指有了裂痕。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1#1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]也许……我们只能一次次目睹这些淋漓的伤口。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_394_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="阿米娅"]凯尔希医生，请放心。无论我面对过谁，又即将要面对谁……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_394_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="阿米娅"]我不会比他们更早倒下。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1072_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="Logos"]血魔大君坠落于未知之地。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1072_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="Logos"]他的王庭，尚有余息。但他的威胁，不复存在。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1072_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="Logos"]只是，我们还是没能阻止，那个诅咒的降临。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_394_1#6$1",focus="m")]
[name="阿米娅"]伦蒂尼姆的方向……到底发生了什么？
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]……原本，自救军认为切断这条物资补给线，将会成为终结战争的手段。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]现在情况有变。这场“战争”，无论如何都不会长久。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]我们需要尽快赶往那里。这具骸骨，或许能成为新的据点，或是，出其不意的交通工具。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]……但愿，它能派上想象中的用场。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avgnew_112_siege_1#10$1",focus="m")]
[name="推进之王"]决战就在眼前。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_394_1#3$1",focus="m")]
[name="阿米娅"]嗯。萨卡兹不能成为下一轮浩劫的元凶。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_394_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="阿米娅"]而且……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_394_1#15$1",focus="m")]
[name="阿米娅"]凯尔希医生。血魔的执念，他的期许，他所说的诅咒，是“源石”。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]……嗯。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1#2",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]最古老的卡兹戴尔比任何文明聚落都先一步接触到了“源石”。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1#2",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]那并非天灾的遗迹，并非堆积在岩层中沉默的矿物。那是一枚古老的“源石”。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1#2",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]由它，诞生了最古老的巫术，最古老的……感染者。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1#2",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]假如血魔真的对这件事有所认知，甚至为此抱有执念，认为它能带来力量……
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_003_kalts_1#2",focus="m")]
[name="凯尔希"]……那接下来所决定的，就远不是伦蒂尼姆一城的命运了。
